title.narrative: Integrated Participatory Development and Management of Irrigation Program

description.narrative: The program will support the Government of Indonesia in implementing its irrigation improvement program (IIP), 2015-2025, which advances the overarching agenda of food security and rural poverty reduction through increased and improved water delivery. The focus of the ADB support will be on improving irrigation system operation, maintenance, and water delivery to farmers. The program will finance a time slice of the government's IIP in 74 districts across 16 provinces from 2017 to 2021. The International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) is providing parallel financing to the Ministry of Agriculture for improved delivery of agricultural services to maximize the benefits of the irrigation improvements.

Output: Irrigation infrastructure improved Indicator: At least 30% of participants for planning and design of infrastructure consultations are women Achievement: 13 Progress/Status: Gender elements have been incorporated in KOMIR, WUAs, and SETIP, and DLI verification guidelines and SETIPS incorporate information on gender. Participation of women in WUAs and in local construction committees involved in the planning and design of irrigation infrastructure are continuously monitored: (a) the number of local construction committee members involved in the planning and design of local irrigation infrastructure investments increased from 25,080 in 2022 to 34,194 in 2023. From 25,080 local construction committee members in 2022, 3,778 were women (15%) and in 2023 from 34,194 local construction committee members, 4,378 are women (13%). Data Source: Program reports, DGWR, MOHA

Output: Irrigation infrastructure improved Indicator: Rehabilitated irrigation infrastructure in program areas increased by 550,000 ha (DLI8) Achievement: 562140 Progress/Status: This DLI was fully achieved in 2023. A total of 562,140 ha area are covered by irrigation infrastructure rehabilitated in accordance with MPWH technical standards and have completed supporting documents including safeguards screening checklist was validated by ADB. ADB still request the EA to continue monitoring compliance of irrigation schemes to institutionalize the practice.
Inputting information into the SIEDI - the centralized database for irrigation infrastructure planning - has satisfactorily progressed from 2022 and is now at 534,716 ha close to the number of ha reported in the DLI 8 achievement. This will be further confirmed during the program completion review mission planned in September 2024.
DILL confirmed that the submission of social and environment screening, and DEDs has been made mandatory for WRAs to access DAK funding. Data Source: DOM-MIS and program reports, DGWR, MOHA

Output: Irrigation infrastructure improved Indicator: Water resources accounting using satellite technology to enable climate change adaptation planning for schemes of more than 200 ha in program area completed and validated Achievement: 20 Progress/Status: Partially achieved. Water resources accounting prepared manually as part of DED preparation. Data Source: Program reports, DGWR

Output: Irrigation operation, maintenance, and management improved Indicator: Effective participation of beneficiaries through operationalizing at least 4,500 WUAs (DLI6) Achievement: 20 Progress/Status: This DLI has been fully achieved in 2022 and validated in 2023. By 2023 DOM evaluated 5,012 WUAs as operationalized. DOM assessed operationalization of 16,000 WUAs that have been inventoried across the program area of 2.5 million ha. The report presenting statistics and analysis of WUA operationalization across the program area shows that (i) 764 WUAs are fully developed (ii) 5,253 WUAs are developing; and (iii) 10,204 WUAs categorized are not yet developed. Data Source: Program reports, DGWR, MOHA

Output: Irrigation operation, maintenance, and management improved Indicator: Improved assessments integrating agriculture and infrastructure development conducted for at least 719 priority schemes (DLI7) Achievement: 3563 Progress/Status: This DLI is completed. MOHA reported that a total of reported that a total of 4,282 PSETKs, covering 2.04 million ha, have been prepared. MOHA continues to monitor the expanded documents of PSETK. The PSETKs serve as input for preparation of RP2Is and annual planning. Data Source: Program reports, DGWR, MOHA

Output: Systems and institutional capacity for sustainable irrigated agriculture strengthened Indicator: Planning and engineering guidelines for irrigation delivery systems are improved (DLI2) Achievement: 100 Progress/Status: All planning and engineering guidelines (SETIP/PSETK, IAMP/RP2I, WUA, PROM, RBO, WRA and KPI) for improved irrigation delivery system have been legalized and disseminated. Data Source: Program reports, DGWR, MOHA

Output: Irrigation operation, maintenance, and management improved Indicator: Irrigation assets registered for 100% of the 2.5 million ha of irrigation systems (DLI5) Achievement: 100 Progress/Status: DOM completed registration of irrigation assets. Irrigation infrastructure covering 2.9 million ha of irrigation systems are registered in the PAKSI system and RBO will update it on a yearly basis.
Further updates will be assessed during the program completion review mission planned in September 2024. Data Source: Irrigation asset management information system progress reports, DGWR

Output: Systems and institutional capacity for sustainable irrigated agriculture strengthened Indicator: Irrigation commission operationalized to enhance institutional capacity for integration and coordination of agriculture and infrastructure development in 74 districts and 14 provinces. (DLI3) Achievement: 88 Progress/Status: ADB validated 88 operationalized irrigation commissions (KOMIR) as reported by MOHA and verified by BPKP, fully achieving the DLI 3 target. MOHA will continue to assess KOMIR operationalization and provide institutional and technical support to weak KOMIRs as part of the capacity development framework (CDF). For 2023, MOHA confirmed that 98% of the provincial and district governments budget were allocated to support KOMIRs in the program area. Data Source: Program reports, DGWR, MOHA

Data Source: Program reports, DGWR Actual value: 812,780

MOHA reported that 74 RP2Is have been integrated into subnational government midterm development plans (RPJMDs). Data Source: Program reports, DGWR, MOHA

Output: Systems and institutional capacity for sustainable irrigated agriculture strengthened Indicator: Capacity development framework implemented and monitored to improve capacity of RBOs, WRAs, and planning agency staff (PAP 5) Achievement: Y Progress/Status: The capacity development framework (CDF) was updated annually comprising technical fiduciary (financial management procurement, and anti-corruption), environment and social safeguards, and management components to improve capacity of participating agencies to comply with government regulations and agree program action plan. Several trainings have been carried out in 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023 by NPMU, DOM, DILL and MOHA.
No capacity building was conducted in 2022 for safeguards, instead an evaluation on safeguard implementation was conducted in Nov 2022. The 2023 annual capacity building on safeguards was conducted on 20 to 22 September and 4 to 6 October 2023 attended by 67 staff in Medan and 90 staff in Makassar. MPWH has issued a regulation for RBOs to establish complaint units. The Mission requests a report on the effectiveness of those units to handle social safeguards complaints. Data Source: Program reports, DGWR, MOHA Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Target year: 2021 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Yields for rice increase by 18% for irrigation schemes supported by IFAD Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Average crop yield at subdistrict level as of 2021 is at 4.98 tons/ha., this do not reflect the conditions for each irrigation system, thus making the program impact difficult to assess. The mission requested EA to extract yield information per irrigation system from satellite-based data set or from PAKSI for each irrigation system in the program area starting from 2017. This will be further validated during the preparation of the government's project completion report which is ongoing and is due by Jun-Jul 2024. Data Source: Crop Statistics Division reports, Ministry of Agriculture-Center for Agricultural Data and Information Systems

Performance of irrigation systems in the program area for (a) 500,000 ha improved by at least 15% 10% and (b) 1.1 million improved at least 5% from baseline level [DLI1] Achievement: 1349547 Progress/Status: Directorate of Operation and Maintenance (DOM) completed baseline surveys to measure the irrigation performance index (IKSI) for 2.9 million ha, exceeding the target of 1,722,223 ha in 74 districts of the program area for national and subnational irrigation schemes. ADB have completed validation of the 2019 baseline survey for 1,722,323 ha. DOM is using an innovative approach combining an android application and a web-based platform integrated with the irrigation management asset information system (PAKSI). DOM legalized the irrigation asset and performance management system (PAKSI) guideline for surface and low land irrigation.
By 2024, ADB confirmed (through the IVA report submitted in June 2024) that by the program closing date of 30 June 2024, IKSI increased by more than 10% for 503,745 ha and by at least 5% for 845,802 ha compared to the 2019 baseline. Data Source: DOM-MIS reports, DGQR

At least 50% of the district RP2I incorporated into five-year district, province, and national plans and budgets (2016 baseline: less than 5% of plans) Achievement: 100 Progress/Status: By the program closing date, 13 provinces and 72 districts have internalized into their RP2I into their respective midterm development plans (RPJMDs) through PPSI (Development and Management of Irrigation Systems Regulation) except for Sumedang and Bojonegoro. Data Source: District and province reports, MOHA-SIPD and DGWR Baseline value: less than 5%
